results.title: Inventory validation catches design defects before deploy
results.expected: validator runs; FAIL items are real design defects to fix

fail: ec-node-loss: [primary] EC 10+4 on 3 cold nodes puts up to 5 shards on one node > 4 parity: losing ONE cold node makes EC data unreadable. Need >= 4 cold nodes, or a narrower code (e.g. 6+3 / 4+2)
ec-rack-loss: [primary] EC 10+4 across 3 racks = 5 shards/rack > 4 parity: a rack failure makes EC data unreadable. Need >= 4 racks or a narrower code
ec-node-loss: [dr] EC 10+4 on 3 cold nodes puts up to 5 shards on one node > 4 parity: losing ONE cold node makes EC data unreadable. Need >= 4 cold nodes, or a narrower code (e.g. 6+3 / 4+2)
ec-rack-loss: [dr] EC 10+4 across 3 racks = 5 shards/rack > 4 parity: a rack failure makes EC data unreadable. Need >= 4 racks or a narrower code

results.title: Phased deploy with health gates (primary + DR)
results.expected: every phase gate passes; total deploy time recorded

results.expected: no restarts, all gates pass again

results.expected: all metrics endpoints return SeaweedFS_* series

results.expected: 1 leader, 2 followers

results.title: Volume servers registered with correct DC / rack (+ disk type)
results.expected: each DC: 6 servers, one hot + one cold per rack; disk type confirmed by volume placement (C04/F02)

results.title: DR is an independent cluster (no shared quorum)
results.expected: disjoint master sets & leaders

results.title: S3 PUT/GET/HEAD/LIST/DELETE integrity (500 objects, 1 KB-2 MB)
results.expected: all objects round-trip with matching MD5

results.title: Multipart upload 64 MB (large XML/EDI batch)
results.expected: ETag multipart, MD5 matches

results.title: Read-your-write across gateways (different filers)
results.expected: object written via s3-01 is immediately readable via s3-02/s3-03

results.title: Landing tier: new bucket data is on SSD with 010 (cross-rack) replicas
results.expected: all archive volumes ssd; each volume has 2 copies in 2 different racks

results.title: S3 IAM: anonymous / wrong secret / out-of-scope actions denied
results.expected: 403 for anon, bad key, bucket create by app, write by monitor

results.title: gRPC mTLS enforced (weed shell without client cert)
results.expected: connection refused / times out without certs
results.evidence: shell could not establish a gRPC session within 15s (TLS handshake rejected)

results.title: Volume write without JWT rejected
results.expected: 401 Unauthorized

results.title: Filer HTTP port bypasses S3 IAM (unauthenticated read)
results.expected: application network cannot read objects via filer :8888
results.evidence: filer HTTP returned object bytes without credentials. Firewall filer 8888/18888 to S3 gateways + ops only, and/or set [jwt.filer_signing(.read)] keys

results.title: Master HTTP /dir/assign reachable without auth
results.expected: application network cannot obtain write tokens from masters
results.evidence: master issued fid+JWT to an anonymous caller - JWT only protects volume servers if master HTTP 9333 is firewalled to cluster members; restrict with -whiteList or [guard] white_list

results.title: S3 gateway crash (s3-01) behind F5 pool
results.expected: application continues; errors only until monitor marks member down

results.title: Filer crash (filer-01)
results.expected: S3 gateways fail over to filer-02/03

results.title: Master LEADER crash
results.expected: new leader elected; writes continue

results.title: Hot volume server crash (hot-01)
results.expected: reads served by cross-rack replica; writes re-routed

results.title: Full RACK r1 loss (master, filer, s3, hot, cold, admin)
results.expected: remaining racks keep S3 read/write for replicated (hot) data

results.title: Rolling restart of every service (upgrade procedure) under load
results.expected: zero application-visible errors with one-at-a-time restarts + gates

results.title: DR seed: initial snapshot replicated (incl. EC'd cold data)
results.expected: every primary object present on DR with same MD5

evidence.note: seed via metadata-log replay silently missed objects (no error logged). A seed MUST be a snapshot/tree copy (Enterprise DM initial snapshot) and MUST be verified by listing+ETag diff before DR is declared ready

results.title: Continuous replication lag (PUT on primary -> visible on DR)
results.expected: lag well under RPO

results.title: Delete propagation (mirror semantics)
results.expected: delete on primary removes object on DR

evidence.note: a mirror is NOT a backup - keep a separate BACKUP policy with deletes OFF

results.title: Replication source filer (filer-01) crash
results.expected: replication continues or catches up after restart without gaps

evidence.note: single-source replication stream lost events written while its source filer was down; replication source must be HA and gaps must be detected by periodic reconcile

results.title: Where do replicated objects land on DR?
results.expected: (design note) DR landing tier

evidence.note: seeded data (incl. data already EC'd on primary) re-lands on DR SSD and is 'new' for quietForSeconds: DR SSD must absorb the whole seed, or seed with a DR-only short-quiet profile

results.title: Same S3 identities work on DR (failover without app re-config)
results.expected: archive-app can LIST/GET on DR

results.title: Unplanned PRIMARY DC loss under load: measured RPO
results.expected: acknowledged writes missing on DR <= RPO window

results.title: Activate DR (GSLB -> DR VIP): LIST/GET/PUT on DR
results.expected: all four operations succeed

evidence.note: lab RTO excludes human decision + DNS TTL

results.title: Controlled failback: restore primary, replay DR writes, re-establish DR
results.expected: DR-era writes present on primary; primary->DR replication resumes

results.title: Post-failback full consistency check primary vs DR
results.expected: no divergence

evidence.note: divergence limited to writes acknowledged by primary but not yet replicated at crash time (the RPO window). They exist only on the recovered primary; reconcile before re-enabling DR mirror deletes.
